name: boron-context
description: Read and write durable, project-scoped context through a local Boron Context runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Durable context continuity for project work
interface.longDescription: Boron Context gives Codex a zero-owned-model, ontology-first context substrate. Trusted lifecycle hooks automatically load a bounded sourced Context Capsule, while MCP tools preserve only verified activities, decisions, evidence, and candidate relations after work.
defaultPrompt: Continue this project using its Boron context.
Record this decision in the project ontology.
Explain the current project state and its evidence.
